item.title: Charleston County Parks brings its Silent Dance Party to Hollywood
item.description: Charleston County Parks is hosting a Silent Dance Party event for ages 8 and up in Hollywood on Friday, January 16! Held at Schroder Recreation Center, this will be the first time Charleston County Parks has offered the event in the Hollywood area.

item.title: One in Three Adults Feel Lonely - Drawing Near to God Offers a Solution
item.description: As loneliness and anxiety continue to rise nationwide, women are increasingly searching for meaningful connections and spiritual grounding, yet many feel lost on where to begin.

item.title: Giannone Brings House-Made Focaccia and Italian Sandwiches to Mount Pleasant
item.description: Giannone, a new wine shop, mercantile and focacceria, has opened its sandwich shop in Mount Pleasant alongside Coastal Crust’s Pizza Bar and Vintage Coffee Cafe.

item.title: Charleston-Area Warming Centers Activated Ahead of Cold Weather
item.description: Due to the cold weather, the following Warming Centers will open Friday, December 19, 2025.

item.title: High Rise Introduces THC Infusions for At-Home and Bar Mixing
item.description: Mix things up and raise your spirits with new THC Infusions from High Rise Beverage Co., designed for mixing a “hightail” or sipping on the rocks.

item.title: Former Champion and Olympic Gold Medalist Belinda Bencic to Play 2026 Charleston Tennis Tournament
item.description: After ending the 2024 season ranked World No. 913, Belinda Bencic has climbed her way back into a top spot on the WTA Tour and now enters the 2026 Credit One Charleston Open, North America’s largest women’s-only professional tennis event

item.title: Meyer Vogl Gallery Announces 2026 Exhibition Program Celebrating 10 Years
item.description: Meyer Vogl Gallery’s 2026 Exhibition Program marked ten years of exhibiting contemporary artists and building a creative community rooted in connection, curiosity, and care.

item.title: Charleston County earns national honor for outstanding financial management
item.description: Charleston County Government has earned national recognition for its management and reporting of public funds, receiving the Government Finance Officers Association’s Triple Crown distinction

item.title: Park Circle Gallery to feature Upcountry Fiber Artists group exhibition
item.description: The City of North Charleston’s Cultural Arts Department is pleased to announce that a group exhibition featuring textile works by the Upcountry Fiber Artists will be on display at Park Circle Gallery from January 7-31, 2026.
